description: This file defines a final utility class 'Count' that encapsulates success and error counts, providing a factory method and getters.

classes.name: Count
classes.description: Immutable class representing counts of successful and error operations, with factory method for instantiation.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Count object with specified success and error counts.

methods.name: getSuccessCount
methods.description: Returns the number of successful operations.

methods.name: getErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the number of erroneous operations.
